summary: Most consequential: gestational-age windows on the page (< 37 weeks for preterm labour, < 22 weeks for the miscarriage branch) are not encoded, so preterm labour and the miscarriage/ectopic diagnoses can fire outside their valid windows. The miscarriage diagnoses are possible where the page says 'likely' (probable). No diagnosis rules exist for severe hypertension or eclampsia, which the page names as headings.
